saints.name: St. Edmund the Martyr
saints.title: King and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: The king of East Anglia who chose death rather than deny Christ or betray his Christian people…
biography: Edmund was king of the East Angles in the ninth century, remembered as a just and devout ruler. When the invading Danish army overran his kingdom, he was defeated, taken captive, and pressed to renounce his faith and rule as a vassal under a heathen overlord.

Refusing to abandon Christ or to abandon his people to unbelievers, he was, according to tradition, bound to a tree, shot through with arrows, and beheaded on 20 November 869. His body was later enshrined at the great abbey of Bury St Edmunds, and he was long venerated as a patron of England.
saints.knownFor: Dying rather than deny Christ under the Danish invaders.
